title: A2-DLC finding event
description: One line of .a2dlc/reports/findings.jsonl: an append-only record of what happened to each finding a check raised. The file is under .a2dlc/reports, so it is out of the tree_hash (gitx.Excluded) and never changes a verdict. A finding is identified by id (kind, source and target) and, within one base_ref, lives from its `raised` event until a `fixed` one. fixed and intentional are derived by the core with no model; false and irrelevant exist only in a `labeled` event that a person or an agent wrote through a2dlc finding label (or the MCP tool), which records who.

base_ref.description: The commit the check compared against: findings are followed only between checks with the same base.

tree_hash.description: The tree the event was observed on; absent in a `labeled` event.

kind.description: raised only. What was found (behavior_divergence, check_finding, test_nop_oracle, uncovered_change, protected_path, tooling...).

source.description: raised only. Who raised it: engine:<engine>, check:<id> or gate:<name>.

target.description: raised only. The finding's target as the receipt names it.

state.description: raised only. parked: an open escalation waits for a person; open: nobody was asked.

decision.description: intentional only. The signed waiver that made it intentional.

outcome.description: labeled only. Never derived: only a label says a finding was false or irrelevant.

by.description: labeled only. Who set the label (recorded, not authenticated).

via.description: labeled only. The surface it came through.
